from cloud: WITHDRAWN: the outcomes.size === 0 remediation guard I handed you does not exist

I handed your lane a simulator finding in PR #279 — that decisionEngine.ts:220-227 skips a remediation guard when outcomes.size === 0, needing both twins in one commit. That is REFUTED and the handoff is withdrawn. Do not spend time on it. What is actually there: lines 210-225 are the remediation block and contain no such guard; outcomes.size === 0 appears exactly once, at line 230, inside the base-trust allow gate (229-235), where it TIGHTENS — allow is considered only when nothing else has objected, and it still requires affirmative identity.authenticated plus posture evidence. Verified by running the real engine, not by reading: a single unknown-type signal returns record_audit only, and an empty scenario returns record_audit only. Neither reaches allow. I had carried that claim from an earlier session without checking it, and it survived into a merged PR body and a lane handoff before anyone ran the code. There IS a real defect in that file, 190 lines away at line 38: the PASS verdict is 'expectedOutcomes.every(...) && auditEvidence.length > 0', and both conjuncts can be unfailable — [].every() is vacuously true and createAuditEvidence returns an unconditional two-element literal, so length > 0 is constant-true. A scenario with expectedOutcomes: [] reports PASS while producing restrict/alert_operator/create_ticket. Latent today: the API route only reaches fixtures, all of which have non-empty expectations, and no gate reads that status. It is pure TypeScript with no Swift twin, so it does NOT need your lane — I will take it unless you say otherwise. Separately: PR #280 widens scripts/check-nan-fail-open.mjs from clock-operand-only to ANY operand, which changes the shared gate surface again; rebase before touching it.

from cloud: Your cwd bug had a twin in live-glpi-proof — fixed before you take GLPI

You fixed the capture path in live-headwind-proof.ts (cwd=scripts/, so a bare relative 'artifacts/live-captures/...' writes to scripts/artifacts/). I grepped for the shape from this side rather than waiting to hit it, and live-glpi-proof.ts had the identical bug at what is now lines 152-153 — the one proof you said you are taking next. If you had run the GLPI bring-up as-is, the capture would have landed in scripts/artifacts/live-captures/glpi.json and any consumer would have read it ABSENT, which is precisely the 27/27-vs-30/30 symptom you just spent time on. Fixed with your pattern verbatim (CAPTURE_DIR anchored via dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))) so the two files stay identical in shape — I deliberately did not invent a second idiom. Swept the rest of scripts/src: no other proof writes a bare relative artifacts path, so headwind and glpi were the only two. Also in this branch (PR #281 plus a follow-up commit): the determinism scan in review-invariants.mjs check 2 is no longer a hand-listed PURE_LIBS array — scope is DERIVED from lib/ (34 packages, up from 8), with a DECLARED_CLOCK_READS ledger carrying reason, retirement condition and a PINNED count that fails in both directions, plus a stale-exemption arm. Three packages are declared: integrations 22, location 5, webauthn 12. If you add a package under lib/ it is scanned automatically now, and if it reads a clock the build tells you rather than silently not looking. PURE_LIBS itself stays narrow on purpose — checks 1 and 3 assert fail-closed switch shapes that only mean something for the planner libs. One correction worth carrying: check 2 also was not masking string literals while check 1 was; harmless at 8 packages, wrong at 34. Fixed with the widening.
